responsibility: Implements rustc’s LLVM-based crate metadata loader by locating and borrowing the encoded Rust metadata payload from compiled artifacts: it reads metadata entries out of `.rlib` archives via LLVM archive support, extracts the metadata section from dylib/object files, and defines the backend’s platform-specific metadata section naming conventions used when writing and later discovering that payload.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `debuginfo/metadata.rs`, this `metadata.rs` handles the compiler’s own crate metadata payload: finding the `.rustc` metadata section in rlibs and dylibs and defining the section name conventions used to store it. It is about loading rustc-encoded crate metadata from artifacts, not constructing LLVM debug information metadata nodes.
